entities.name: Antiquities
entities.description: The second Magic expansion, built around artifacts and telling the story of the Brothers' War between Mishra and Urza.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: One of two brothers who discover a stone in the Caves of Koilos and fight the Brothers' War against Mishra.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: One of two brothers who discover a stone in the Caves of Koilos and fight the Brothers' War against Urza.

entities.name: Brothers' War
entities.description: An epic war between Urza and Mishra for control of both halves of the stone, fought with ancient Thran machines, ending in the Sylex Blast.

entities.name: Thran Empire
entities.description: An ancient empire whose artifacts and advanced machines of war are discovered on Terisiare.

entities.name: Terisiare
entities.description: The continent of Dominaria where ancient Thran artifacts are discovered.

entities.name: Caves of Koilos
entities.description: The place where Urza and Mishra discover a stone.

entities.name: Mightstone and Weakstone
entities.description: The two halves into which the discovered stone splits when disturbed.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: The source of evil unleashed on Dominaria when the stone splits.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane on which the Brothers' War takes place.

entities.name: Sylex Blast
entities.description: The culmination of the Brothers' War, plunging the world into the Ice Age.

entities.name: Ice Age
entities.description: The age into which the world is plunged after the Sylex Blast.

events.summary: Ancient artifacts and machines of war of the Thran Empire are discovered on Terisiare.
events.quote: Ancient artifacts of the Thran Empire are discovered on the continent of Terisiare

events.summary: Urza and Mishra discover a stone in the Caves of Koilos; disturbed, it splits into Mightstone and Weakstone and unleashes Phyrexia's evil on Dominaria.
events.quote: unleashing the evil of Phyrexia on Dominaria

events.summary: The Brothers' War erupts between Urza and Mishra for control of both halves of the stone, with ancient Thran machines used in battle.
events.quote: an epic war between Urza and Mishra for control of both halves of the stone

events.summary: The war culminates in the Sylex Blast, plunging the world into the Ice Age.
events.quote: plunging the world into the Ice Age

relations.note: Fight the Brothers' War over the stone.
relations.quote: an epic war between Urza and Mishra
